expected_behavior: The parser MUST parse this long ~60-line recap in full without silent truncation — extracting the head terms (vessel, parties, ports, cargo, laycan, freight, split laytime, dem/des, commission, arbitration/law, CP form) AND populating additional_terms with the many rider clauses and subs with all sub-lift deadlines, with no field dropped because it appears late in the body.

input.subject: CLEAN RECAP // MV PACIFIC ENVOY // 54,000 MT HSS IN BULK // CONSTANTZA-ISKENDERUN
input.body:
Gents,

Following our telcon we are pleased to recap clean the below fixture, all subs lifted except as noted, owise as per pro-forma GENCON 94 with charterers' rider clauses 20-58 logically amended:

1. MV PACIFIC ENVOY
2. Supramax bulk carrier, 56,800 dwt on 12.85 m SSW, blt 2013 Tsuneishi
3. Marshall Islands flag, geared 4 x 30 MT cranes with grabs
4. GRT/NRT 32,500 / 18,900, LOA 190.0 m, beam 32.26 m
5. OWNERS: Aegean Dry Bulk Maritime Inc, Piraeus (disponent owners)
6. HEAD OWNERS: Tsuneishi Kamtetsu Shipping, Tokyo
7. CHARTERERS: Cargill International SA, Geneva
8. ACCOUNT: Cargill Metals (for receivers' account TBN)
9. CARGO: 54,000 MT 10 pct moloo charterers' option, hot rolled steel sheets (HSS) in coils, in bulk
10. LOAD PORT: 1 sb 1 sa Constantza, Romania
11. DISCH PORT: 1 sb 1 sa Iskenderun, Turkey
12. LAYCAN: 16/24 June 2026
13. FREIGHT: USD 23.75 pmt FIOST, lashed/secured/dunnaged, free of all port dues both ends
14. FREIGHT PAYMENT: 95 pct freight less addcomm payable within 5 banking days after completion of loading and master's signing/releasing b/l marked freight payable as per cp; balance 5 pct plus/minus dem/des payable within 15 banking days after completion of discharge and owners' final invoice
15. LOAD RATE: 8,000 MT pwwd shinc, weather permitting
16. LOAD TERMS: SHINC, free in trimmed, shippers to provide all dunnage and lashing materials
17. LOAD HOURS: 0700-1900 grabs working, gear by ship
18. DISCH RATE: 6,000 MT pwwd shex eiu
19. DISCH TERMS: SHEX EIU, Fridays and holidays excepted unless used
20. DISCH HOURS: 0800-1700 Mon-Thu, 0800-1200 Fri
21. DEMURRAGE: USD 16,500 PDPR both ends
22. DESPATCH: half demurrage, laytime saved working time, both ends
23. DEM/DES PAYMENT: payable within 30 days of presentation of fully documented claim with time sheets, SOF and NOR
24. NOR: WIPON WIBON WIFPON WICCON, ATDNSHINC, NOR tendered any time day or night SHINC
25. LAYTIME: non-reversible, to commence 1300 hrs if NOR tendered before noon, 0800 next working day if tendered pm
26. TTL TIME LOST waiting for berth to count as laytime / time on demurrage
27. BENDS agents: load Constantza Agency Maritime SRL; disch Mersin Denizcilik AS, Iskenderun
28. ADDRESS COMMISSION: 2.5 pct to charterers
29. BROKERAGE: 1.25 pct to Aegean Dry chartering
30. TOTAL COMMISSION: 3.75 pct on freight, dead freight and demurrage
31. CP FORM: GENCON 1994 as amended
32. ARBITRATION: London, LMAA Terms 2021, English law to apply
33. SMALL CLAIMS: claims up to USD 100,000 under LMAA SCP
34. GA / York Antwerp Rules 2016, settled London
35. BIMCO ISPS/MTSA clause to apply
36. BIMCO standard war risks clause CONWARTIME 2013
37. BIMCO sanctions clause for time/voyage charter parties 2020
38. P&I: owners' vessel entered with Gard, full club entry
39. Owners warrant vessel is not on any sanctions list and beneficial ownership not sanctioned
40. Vessel/owners to comply with EU and OFAC sanctions regimes for Black Sea trade
41. Holds on arrival load port clean swept, dry, free of loose rust scale, fit to receive intended cargo to shippers'/surveyor's satisfaction
42. Hold cleaning at owners' time and expense; if rejected, time not to count until passed
43. Owners to provide last 3 cargoes and confirm no IMSBC-listed prior cargo incompatibility
44. Stevedore damage to be reported in writing within 24 hrs, settled between owners and stevedores, charterers to assist
45. Master to cooperate with charterers' supercargo if appointed
46. Owners to allow charterers to load deck cargo at charterers' risk if requested - sub owners' approval of stability
47. Bunkers / speed-consumption warranty: abt 13 kn laden on abt 28 mt IFO + 0.1 mt MGO at sea good weather
48. Weather routing by charterers, advisory only, master retains discretion for safe navigation
49. ETA notices: 10/7/5/3/2/1 days, master to advise on sailing from load port
50. Freight tax/dues on cargo for charterers' account, on vessel/freight for owners' account
51. Sub-lift 1: subject charterers' board approval - to be lifted latest 1700 hrs LT 26 May 2026
52. Sub-lift 2: subject shippers' confirmation of stem and laydays - to be lifted latest 1200 hrs LT 27 May 2026
53. Sub-lift 3: subject receivers' approval of vessel and documentary instructions - latest 1700 hrs LT 28 May 2026
54. All subs to be lifted in writing failing which fixture deemed null and void without penalty either side
55. Owners to confirm vessel's class fully maintained, no outstanding class recommendations affecting trading
56. Charterers' option to substitute disch port to Mersin against same terms, owners' agreement not to be unreasonably withheld
57. Confidentiality: this recap and its terms strictly private and confidential between the parties
58. Otherwise as per owners' pro-forma CP logically amended to reflect main terms above

Pls reconfirm all in order and revert with any comments by 1200 hrs LT tomorrow 24 May.

Best regards,
Dimitris Pappas
Aegean Dry Bulk - Chartering Desk, Piraeus
